findings.detail: getSuggestions and all rules/*.ts are pure functions over their args; engine.ts returns [] for undefined character and composes five pure rule modules + orderSuggestions with no storage/navigation/dialog/network. Verified by engine.test.ts purity test (deep-frozen character + localStorage setItem/getItem spies assert no calls). dispatchAction (useAssistantActions) only navigates or SEEDS the RollDialog via resolveReminderBaseTarget — it calls no advance/apply/mutate handler. AssistantPanel/SuggestionItem expose only onAction/onDismiss/onSnooze; AssistantPanel.test.tsx 'never mutates a frozen character' asserts invoking every control hits only those callbacks (onAction x2, onDismiss x1, onSnooze x1).

findings.area: actions route through existing player-confirmed flows (FR-6, Finding 2)
findings.detail: navigate uses the navigate(page,subTab) already threaded through App.tsx; roll mirrors CombatDashboard.handleRollReminder — resolveReminderBaseTarget (extracted verbatim) + a NEW shell reminderRollState {name,baseTarget,difficulty} feeding a second RollDialog with defaultDifficulty. The quick-roll {name,baseTarget} state and its RollDialog are left untouched (confirmed in App.tsx diff).

SuggestionSource.getSuggestions returns Suggestion[] | Promise<Suggestion[]>; deterministicSuggestionSource is always synchronous and both call sites (App.tsx rawSuggestions useMemo, and the source wrapper) narrow with Array.isArray(r)?r:[]. An async LLM-backed source is a non-breaking extension.

findings.area: combat reminders consumed not forked (FR-8.5, Finding 6)
findings.detail: rules/reminders.ts imports and calls deriveAllReminders and maps CombatReminder->Suggestion (id namespaced reminder:${r.id}, rationale=r.description, citation=r.citation VERBATIM). CombatDashboard.tsx is otherwise unchanged except resolveReminderBaseTarget was extracted verbatim to src/logic/reminders-target.ts and re-imported (output identical; unused imports dropped). engine.test.ts asserts reminder suggestions equal deriveAllReminders(...) mapped with citation verbatim.

AssistantPanel returns null when !isOpen (AssistantPanel.test.tsx asserts no dialog rendered when closed = zero layout footprint). Open state is an intentional modal (role=dialog, aria-modal=true, focus trap) matching the command palette; Escape, backdrop, and close button all dismiss and restore focus to the trigger via previousFocusRef + requestAnimationFrame.

A single memoized `suggestions` (visibleSuggestions over rawSuggestions, dismiss/snooze-filtered BEFORE the count) feeds both Navigation assistantCount={suggestions.length} and the AssistantPanel suggestions prop. The dismiss prune is a WRITE confined to a shell useEffect (the sole sanctioned react-hooks/set-state-in-effect disable), never in render; visibleSuggestions stays pure. Integration commit explicitly verified this seam.

findings.area: calculated totals carry breakdown Tooltips (FR-11, calculated-totals steering)
findings.detail: SuggestionItem renders every suggestion.totals entry through the shared Tooltip + TooltipTriggerCell using engine-supplied `lines` (never recomputed in the UI); hover (desktop) / tap (touch) via the shared component. Encumbrance total shows Weapons/Armour/Trappings/Coins + Max breakdown; corruption shows TB/WPB/Pure Soul; advancement shows unspent XP. AssistantPanel.test.tsx asserts the breakdown lines are revealed.

findings.area: rulebook citations on every encoded rule (FR-10, rules-compliance steering)
findings.detail: Each native rule module carries a `// Core p.NNN` comment AND the same string as Suggestion.citation: advancement 'Core p.48', encumbrance 'Core p.293: Overburdened', corruption 'Core p.183: Corrupting (+ Pure Soul talent, p.182)'. Verified p.293 against docs/WarhammerFantasyRoleplay4e.md: 'Up to limit -> No penalties', 'Up to double limit -> -1 Movement (min 3), -10 Agility, +1 Travel Fatigue' — penalties begin above the limit, so firing at current>max with a '-1 Movement' rationale is accurate. Reminder items carry r.citation verbatim.

findings.area: flagged ambiguities confirmed, not guessed (OQ-2, OQ-5)
findings.detail: FEAT-003 records both flagged to the user via send_message(warning). OQ-2: user chose `>=` (match the app's getCorruptionStatus danger band); corruption.ts implements `corr >= threshold` with Pure Soul included via getCorruptionThreshold(chars, getPureSoulLevel(talents)), and engine.test.ts asserts >= semantics (below=none, at=due, over=due) + Pure Soul raising the threshold. OQ-5: user chose keep the fixed 24h snooze + 'assistant-dismissals' key — matches dismissStore.ts. Neither was silently invented.

Recorded in all three FEAT findings and the ITERATION-1 integration commit: npx tsc --build --force --noEmit = 0 errors; npm run build = success; vitest --run = 486 files / 5329 tests pass (482->484->486 across FEATs, pre-existing suite unchanged); npx eslint . = 0 errors with only the 3 PRE-EXISTING react-refresh/only-export-components warnings (CommandPaletteContext.tsx, CombatPage.tsx, SettingsPage.tsx — not assistant files). The only new suppression is the single sanctioned set-state-in-effect disable in App.tsx. Evidence is present and internally consistent; no spot-check raised a specific doubt requiring a re-run.

GearTab's two eW+eA+eT+eCoin sites were refactored to calculateCarriedEncumbrance; PrintLayout was deliberately NOT, because its printed total excludes coins and omits sturdyLevel — substituting the coins-inclusive helper would change the printed total (a user-visible behaviour change) and break its integration test. This is a sound behaviour-preserving decision, not a defect; any change to make the print total match the Gear tab is a separate product decision. No action required.
